title: Website: Previous Portfolio Site
pitch: My previous portfolio, self-hosted end to end on a DigitalOcean droplet.
description: An earlier React portfolio showcasing my game design, art, and coding projects, self-hosted from scratch on a DigitalOcean droplet using NGINX and Ubuntu. It predates this Next.js version, but is where I first learned to own a deployment end to end rather than relying on a managed platform.
